name: arus_kas_tidak_langsung
query:
WITH
  base AS (
    SELECT k.code AS akun_kode, k.nama AS akun_nama,
           kl.noklasifikasi AS klno,
           COALESCE(sk.cash_flow_type,'operating') AS cft,
           SUM(G1.kredit - G1.debit)::numeric(18,2) AS nilai
    FROM (
      SELECT g.id AS gid, g.tanggal::date AS d, g.department_id AS department_id,
             g.project_id AS project_id, jv.account_id AS account_id,
             jv.cost_code_id AS cost_code_id, jv.debit AS debit, jv.kredit AS kredit
      FROM g_jurnal g JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
      WHERE g.status = 'approved'
    ) G1
    JOIN kiraan  k  ON k.id  = G1.account_id
    JOIN subklas sk ON sk.id = k.subclassification_id
    JOIN klas    kl ON kl.id = sk.classification_id
    WHERE COALESCE(k.is_cash,'0') <> '1' {andWhere}
    GROUP BY k.code, k.nama, kl.noklasifikasi, COALESCE(sk.cash_flow_type,'operating')
    HAVING SUM(G1.kredit - G1.debit) <> 0
  ),
kasakhir AS (
  SELECT SUM(jv.debit - jv.kredit)::numeric(18,2) AS kas_akhir
  FROM g_jurnal g JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
  JOIN kiraan k ON k.id = jv.account_id
  WHERE g.status = 'approved' AND COALESCE(k.is_cash,'0') = '1'
),
mv AS (
  SELECT 1 AS section_urut, 'ARUS KAS DARI AKTIVITAS OPERASI' AS section,
         1 AS blok_urut, ''::text AS blok,
         ''::text AS akun_kode, 'Kenaikan (penurunan) saldo dana' AS akun_nama,
         SUM(nilai)::numeric(18,2) AS nilai
  FROM base WHERE klno IN (4,5,6,7,8,9)
  HAVING SUM(nilai) <> 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1, 'ARUS KAS DARI AKTIVITAS OPERASI', 2, 'Penyesuaian (perubahan aset & liabilitas operasi)',
         akun_kode, akun_nama, nilai
  FROM base WHERE klno NOT IN (4,5,6,7,8,9) AND cft NOT IN ('investing','financing')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2, 'ARUS KAS DARI (UNTUK) AKTIVITAS INVESTASI', 1, '',
         akun_kode, akun_nama, nilai
  FROM base WHERE klno NOT IN (4,5,6,7,8,9) AND cft = 'investing'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, 'ARUS KAS DARI (UNTUK) AKTIVITAS PENDANAAN', 1, '',
         akun_kode, akun_nama, nilai
  FROM base WHERE klno NOT IN (4,5,6,7,8,9) AND cft = 'financing'
)
SELECT mv.section_urut, mv.section, mv.blok_urut, mv.blok,
       mv.akun_kode, mv.akun_nama, mv.nilai,
       (SELECT kas_akhir FROM kasakhir) AS kas_akhir
FROM mv
ORDER BY mv.section_urut, mv.blok_urut, mv.akun_kode {andOrder} {limit}
